findings.problem: The translation is missing the conjunction 'o a' (or to) between 'sí mismo/a' and 'la familia', which makes the phrase grammatically incorrect and slightly ambiguous.
findings.fix: Sentirse mal consigo mismo — un fracaso, o haberse fallado a sí mismo/a o a la familia
findings.en: Feeling bad about yourself — a failure, or letting yourself/family down
findings.es: Sentirse mal consigo mismo — un fracaso, o haberse fallado a sí mismo/a la familia
